document: Recovered General Detailing Knowledge, Rules, and Conventions

A1_nominal_cover_definition.applied_to: reinforcement NEAREST to concrete surface (e.g. links in beam, not main bars)

A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.rule: Nominal cover to the LINK must be such that resulting cover to MAIN BAR is at least: bar_dia_main (or equivalent bn) + Δcdev
A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.formula: c_link >= c_main_required - link_dia, where c_main_required = bar_dia_main + Δcdev
A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.no_links_rule: c_nom >= bar_dia + Δcdev directly to bar

A3_surface_treatment_addition.rule: Where special surface treatments used (e.g. bush hammering): add expected depth of treatment to nominal cover

A4_aggregate_rule.rule: Nominal cover >= maximum (nominal) aggregate size dg

A5_durability_cover.rule: Cover for durability governed by exposure class per EC2 Clause 4.2. Typical values in manual are guide only; Designer must confirm.

A6_fire_cover.rule: Cover for fire resistance is expressed as AXIS DISTANCE (centre of bar to concrete surface), not nominal cover (BS EN 1992-1-2).

A7_fire_spalling_threshold.rule: IF nominal cover to outermost steel > 40mm (i.e. axis distance to main reinforcement > 70mm) THEN spalling danger in fire -> provide surface mesh: spacing <= 100mm, dia >= 4mm

A8_beam_top_cover_note.rule: Top cover to beam bars may be determined by slab or transverse beam reinforcement: cover_beam = cover_slab + bar_dia_slab

A9_bundled_bar_equivalent_dia.source: Section 5.4.5, page 43; referenced in Sections 6.3.2 and 6.4.2

H1_nominal_lap_minimum_for_nominal_bars.rule: Lap lengths for nominal bars etc. shall NOT be less than max(15 * bar_size, 200mm)

H2_slab_simplified_curtailment_condition.rule: Simplified curtailment for slabs (Figs 6.3-6.4) permitted ONLY when analysis is for single load case all-spans-loaded per UK NA 5.1.3(1)P AND no shear reinforcement required

H3_fabric_lap_area_allowance.rule: For coffered slabs with fabric, if designer does not specify additional lap area, 22% assumed for 300mm laps

H4_detailing_information_cover_defaults.rule: Standard cover for detailing information: 20mm internal, 40mm external (slabs §6.2.3); 35mm internal, 40mm external (corbels §6.9.3)

H5_direct_support_reduced_anchorage.rule: Direct supports: anchorage beyond face of support may be reduced to d, but not less than max(0.3 * l_b_rqd, 10 * bar_dia, 100mm)
H5_direct_support_reduced_anchorage.exception: Abnormally high loading or point loads close to support require EC2 Sec 8 & 9 check

H6_indirect_support_full_anchorage.rule: Indirect supports: full anchorage l_bd applies from line of contact. No reduction permitted.

H7_partial_fixity_slab_top_bars.rule: Minimum top reinforcement where partial fixity exists: 25% of maximum required in span (>= As_min). May be reduced to 15% for END support.

H8_moment_connection_corner_bar.rule: For L-bar beam-to-edge-column: standard bend radius permitted PROVIDED a bar of same size OR GREATER is placed inside corner, normal to it.

H9_wide_beam_narrow_column_corbel.rule: IF beam_width > column_width + 2 * d THEN provide design transverse top steel at column position for corbel action (plus tying)

H10_direct_support_transverse_wire_excep.rule: For direct supports: l_bd may be taken < l_b_min provided >= 1 transverse wire welded within support, >= 15mm from face

I2_zone_subcount_brackets.format: Total count followed by sub-counts per zone in parentheses: '20H10-63-150T1 (12) (8)'

I3_link_elevation_notation.format: count/spacing e.g. '19/300 5/200 13/150'; '37 H12 07 LINKS P.A.S'; '29 H12 08 300 LINK CLOSERS'

I5_spacer_bar_beam_notation.source: Model Detail MB1, page 82; Section 6.3.4, page 79

I7_curtailment_30deg_mark.rule: Curtailed bars in elevation identified by short 30° oblique lines at bar end with bar mark

I8_fan_zone_bars.rule: Indicator line on datum radius for measuring pitch; ends located to datum; notation includes s.o.p (setting out point)

I9_cranked_bent_bars_plan.rule: Clarify flat vs upright fixing with sections and notes
